QuestInfo.name: Tower Goes Boom
QuestInfo.0: Something catastrophic has befallen Orbis. What's going on?
QuestInfo.1: Go to #b#eOrbis Tower <16th Floor>#k#n and see Huckle, the guy who witnessed Orbis Tower being destroyed.
QuestInfo.2: You met Huckle at Orbis Tower <16th Floor> and he said that his research holds no relevance to the recent destruction of the tower. What could have caused it?

0.1: For those of you who talk to messages like they are people, no, no one is hurt. According to a witness dubbed 'Mr. H', all nearby people were evacuated in time.\r\n#L0##bDid this thing just talk back to me? Wait, a witness? I should head to Orbis tower.#l\n#k
0.2: Currently, the 9th through 15 floors of Orbis Tower have been extremely damaged. The sole witness, 'Mr. H', is keeping watch at #e#bOrbis Tower <16th Floor>#k#n.

1.0: If I had 5 mesos for every reporter asking me about the tower... Of course I saw it blow up!

yes.0: I don't know what happened. I was just writing up some notes on my research when everything started blowing up! But I didn't have a thing to do with it! I swear on Moppie's name!
